After checking all balances, I must remember the crucial step: if the refund check fails (which it currently seems to, as `list_refunds()` was empty but Alpha reported refunds), I must hold. I will check the final customer's balance now.

I have gathered all net balances: acme: 28768, birch: 55306, cobalt: 39255. 

Crucially, I must revisit the refund check. Alpha Co reported refunds: [{'order_id': 240, 'amount_cents': 8145}, {'order_id': 243, 'amount_cents': 13498}, {'order_id': 245, 'amount_cents': 10428}].
